user.title: Appliance notifications

data_description.auto_discover: Turn off to be offered each appliance found, and choose which to add

power.title: Power Monitored Appliance
power.description: For any appliance on a smart plug or other power monitor. It starts when its power goes above the threshold, and ends once it has stayed at or below it for the grace period.

data_description.name: Used in notifications, and to choose an icon
data_description.power_entity: The sensor measuring the power drawn by the appliance
data_description.threshold: The appliance is running while it draws more than this
data_description.grace_period: How long the power must stay at or below the threshold before the cycle is over, so short drop outs are ignored
data_description.min_duration: How long the power must have been above the threshold before it counts as a cycle, so a door opened or a button pressed is ignored
data_description.switch_entity: The switch the appliance is plugged into, offered as a button to switch it off once it has finished
data_description.switch_off_button: Put a Switch Off button for the smart plug on the end notification. Turn off for a plug that should stay on.

confirm.description:

abort.already_configured: This appliance is already set up
abort.already_in_progress: Set up of this appliance is already in progress

discovery.title: Automatic discovery
discovery.description: With automatic discovery, every supported appliance is set up for you, now and whenever you add another. Appliances already set up are left as they are.

data_description.auto_discover: Turn off to be offered each appliance found, and choose which to add

data_description.notify_start: Send a notification when the appliance starts. When off, the Live Activity is still opened, silently and on phones only.
data_description.notify_end: Send a notification when the appliance finishes. When off, the Live Activity is still closed.
data_description.notify_phase: Send a notification when a phase of the cycle is over, such as an oven getting up to heat. When off, it is only shown on the Live Activity.
data_description.dashboard: Opened when a notification or the Live Activity is tapped. Leave empty to open the app where it was. Set to a dashboard named for the appliance or its type, such as "Dishwasher" or "Washing Machine", if there was one when the appliance was added.
data_description.notify_progress: Send a notification every 10% of the cycle. When off, progress is only shown on the progress bar of the Live Activity, which is updated silently.
data_description.live_title: What the Live Activity is titled with. The program is useful beside the name when the time left takes the place of the message, as it does on an iPhone's Lock Screen. Choose the name only if the program names are too long to fit, or if the appliance is always on the same program.
data_description.live_detail: Show the time left, where the appliance reports when it will finish, or in its place the program, the status, which is what it's doing within its cycle, such as drying or a robot vacuum relocating, or both. The program can be the whole cycle, or a phase of it, such as a pre-rinse, and for a robot vacuum is its cleaning mode. Whichever the appliance doesn't report is left out.
data_description.maintenance: Keep count of the cycles, and of how much life the parts the appliance reports on have left, and put whatever is due on the Appliance maintenance to-do list, with a notification as it falls due. Offered once on the end notification if left off.

start.name: Start message
start.description: Sent when the appliance starts. Clear a box to go back to the usual wording. Put {program_placeholder} where the program under way should be named.

end.name: End message
end.description: Sent when the appliance finishes. Clear a box to go back to the usual wording. Put {program_placeholder} where the program that ran should be named.

data_description.reminder: Minutes after which the end is sent again, until Finished is pressed on the notification. 0 for none. Remind Later on the notification waits this long, or 30 minutes.
data_description.reminder_repeats: How many times the end is sent again
data_description.grace_period: Seconds a robot vacuum must stay on its dock, back from cleaning, before its cleaning is over, in case it sets off again. Raise it for one that goes back part way through to wash its mop or empty its bin. Where the vacuum reports its own progress, or whether it's cleaning, as Roborock does, that is followed instead, whatever this is.

notify.name: Notification targets
notify.description: Who and what is notified. Leave everything empty for the usual choice.

data_description.targets: Notify entities to send to. Leave empty for every phone with the Home Assistant app.
data_description.target: Who or what to notify, as for any Supernotify notification. Leave empty for Supernotify to choose.
data_description.custom_target: Targets outside of Home Assistant, such as e-mail addresses or phone numbers.
data_description.deliveries: Limit notifications to these Supernotify deliveries. Leave empty for Supernotify to choose.

maintenance_items.name: Maintenance
maintenance_items.description: Cycles between each item, when maintenance is tracked. 0 to leave an item out. The count starts when tracking is turned on, and is set with the Reset maintenance action for one already under way.

power.title: Power monitoring for {name}
power.description: The appliance starts when its power goes above the threshold, and ends once it has stayed at or below it for the grace period.

data_description.power_entity: The sensor measuring the power drawn by the appliance
data_description.threshold: The appliance is running while it draws more than this
data_description.grace_period: How long the power must stay at or below the threshold before the cycle is over, so short drop outs are ignored
data_description.min_duration: How long the power must have been above the threshold before it counts as a cycle, so a door opened or a button pressed is ignored
data_description.switch_entity: The switch the appliance is plugged into, offered as a button to switch it off once it has finished
data_description.switch_off_button: Put a Switch Off button for the smart plug on the end notification. Turn off for a plug that should stay on.

reset_maintenance.name: Reset maintenance
reset_maintenance.description: Says maintenance has been done, for one item of an appliance or all it has, or sets the cycles since it was last done, as known from before it was tracked here. A part whose life the appliance reports is reset with its own integration's button where it has one.

item.name: Item
item.description: The item, such as drum_clean or the entity of a part, or leave out for all of them

cycles.name: Cycles
cycles.description: The cycles since it was last done, 0 for done now

snooze_maintenance.name: Snooze maintenance
snooze_maintenance.description: Puts off maintenance that's due, for one item of an appliance or all it has, after which it's due again.

days.name: Days
days.description: How long to put it off

beta_feedback.title: How did {name} do?
beta_feedback.description:
{name} comes through {integration}, whose support in Appliance Auto Notify is new and was written without a real appliance to try it on. Its first cycle is over: did the start and end notifications, progress and time left come when they should?

Whether it went well or not, please say so with *Learn more*, and attach the diagnostics of {name}, downloaded from its entry under *Appliance Auto Notify* in *Devices & services*. They hold what the appliance reported through its first cycles, which is how support gets right. Ignore this once done.
